diagnosis.what_happened: The orchestrator and writer reported regression hypotheses in a single consolidated summary table across outcomes rather than adhering to the mandatory institutional 3-Table Standard.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Consolidating model summary, ANOVA, coefficients, and correlations into a single row or single table violates the AcademicSuite and Iranian thesis institutional standard which mandates three separate tables per regression model.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Each regression hypothesis must be reported via exactly three separate tables: Table 1 (Bivariate Pearson Correlation Matrix), Table 2 (Model Summary & Combined ANOVA with 11 columns: SS, df, MS, F, p, R, R², Adj R², SE, DW), and Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity: B, SE, Beta, t, p, Tolerance, VIF).
diagnosis.rationale_why: Statistical rigor in graduate dissertations demands explicit decomposition of explained variance (ANOVA) and multicollinearity diagnostics distinct from the bivariate correlation baseline and coefficient estimates.

desired_behavior: Strictly enforce the 3-Table Standard for all regression model reporting across JSON schemas, markdown narratives, and DOCX tables.
generalization: Never report regression models as a single consolidated row or table; always scaffold and generate Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (ANOVA & Model Summary), and Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity).
